### [612] [Micius-Flash: Lightweight Agentic Intelligence for Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10015)
*Hongcheng Gao,Weiheng Li,Yipeng Wei,Yu Lei,Shuo Sun,Yi Li,Yajiao Wang,Jie Luo,Jianwei Wen,Xinyi Zhou,Hongda Li,Yibing Zhang,Henghui Sun,Yufan Zhou,Tianfang Hao,Naihao Xue,Hailong Qu,Jingjing Zhou,Peng Xu,Yongzheng Wei,Yichen Zhu,Ziying Wang,Yibo Wang,Jianshu Zeng,Yuhang Lei,Zeqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Micius-Flash 是一个 27B 参数、面向科学与工程（以半导体为主）的原生多模态智能体模型，具备 256K 上下文。论文的核心是"知识树驱动的数据飞轮 + 四类专家模型 + 多教师在策略蒸馏（MOPD）"，配套 Micius Harness 工程工作台（EDA/KiCad/Godot/GPU 工具接入与远程执行）。在 25 个基准上，硬件代码平均 64.2%（较同规模基线 +15.0），半导体智能体基准 62.4%（+17.2），视觉与部分代码基准取得最佳或次佳，同时保持通用推理能力竞争力，模型以开源形式发布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文针对大模型在科学与工程领域落地的三项核心缺口：①工程知识（尤其半导体）碎片化，通用语料覆盖不足，需要系统化知识组织、数据合成与质量闭环；②工程任务需要互补能力（领域知识、多模态、硬件编码、工具使用），单一模型直接混合训练易发生能力干扰或通用能力退化；③真实工程流程需要专用执行基础设施——专业软件接口各异、多阶段任务需协同工具访问、环境配置与可执行工作流。已有工作多依赖静态文本监督，缺少由执行结果验证的训练信号与可落地的智能体运行时。作者以半导体（器件物理、工艺、电路设计、验证）作为主要评测与优化域，因其同时要求看懂原理图、生成 RTL/EDA 脚本并依据仿真反馈迭代，最能检验"知识+工具+反馈"闭环能力。

Method: 整体为四部分。1）数据层：知识树驱动的数据飞轮——先依权威标准与核心文献构建/递归扩展知识树（并补充依赖与跨分支关系形成知识图谱），再以节点/子图为索引做定向数据合成（单节点、父子对、跨分支组合，按节点数与推理跳数控难度；编码任务以节点/GitHub/手册为种子，生成 spec-to-RTL、代码补全、缺陷修复、testbench 生成，经编译+仿真验证；视觉任务由原理图/波形/layout/RTL 仿真代码渲染成图，剔除纯文本模型即可答对的样本），最后做三维度质量校验（多样性、难度分布、问答质量），并用小规模 SFT+独立评测评估数据训练效用；失败样本回溯到知识节点定位成因（覆盖不足/粒度过粗→扩节点；组合或难度覆盖不足→调采样；证据缺失/答案错误→改数据），形成闭环。2）智能体环境与任务合成：依据领域分类法收集 500+ 真实工作场景并由专家审核，Search Agent 检索真实数据构建工作区，将 Python 包/工具库/接口封装为可调用工具，用 DAG 建模多步任务依赖，并利用"任务构造者掌握环境信息、执行者仅知目标"的信息不对称评估主动信息获取；并在游戏开发域验证可迁移性。3）后训练：SFT 从基座分别微调四个教师（半导体知识与推理、编码、多模态、Agent 工具使用），同时对基座做监督预热初始化学生；随后 MOPD——当前学生在线生成轨迹，按任务类别路由至对应教师做 token 级分布监督，采用 forward KL 目标，保留教师 top-32 token 概率并将其余概率质量聚合为单一 tail 类别，按类别平均有效 token 位置并加权合并类别损失。训练中引入经编译/仿真/沙箱执行验证的工程样例与工具使用轨迹。4）Micius Harness：Capability Broker（确定性能力域/阶段过滤与工具白名单强制）、Engineering Viewer（带 artifact identity 与内容哈希校验的版图/netlist/波形/PCB 查看器）、Remote Execution Runtime（本地与远程统一任务接口、文件上传显式审批、凭据留在宿主侧、结果哈希校验、以保存的调用标识查询恢复、不确定结果不重复提交）。

Result: 在 25 个基准、约 1.5 万样本上评测：硬件编码 12 个基准平均 64.2%，较同规模 Qwen3.8-27B 高 15.0 分；半导体智能体基准 62.41%，较同规模基线高 17.2 分。知识推理：SemiBench 49.70%（较 Qwen3.8-27B +7.19），SuperGPQA 四个半导体子集全面优于基线（Circuits 72.22、Emfield 86.36、Microelec 84.00 为最佳、Physics 70.49）。视觉：RFSchemBench 72.40%、CircuitSense 71.00% 为有报告模型中最佳，PCB-Bench 80.60% 居次。编码：VerilogEval-v2 86.80%、RTLLM-v2 79.10% 与 GPT-5.6 Sol 并列最佳，NetlistBench 83.80%、PyHDL-Eval 65.80%、CreativEval 79.20%、VHDLBench 76.20%，Rule2DRC 48.30% 居次。智能体：三个智能体工程基准（Semiconductor Agent 62.41、PCB Agent 83.30、GameCraft-Bench 50.50）均居有报告模型第二，落后 GPT-5.6 Sol 但领先多数开源模型。通用能力：HMMT 87.90%、MMLU-Pro 84.20%，保持竞争力。案例研究：Sobel 流式边缘检测器从微架构规格走到 100 MHz 时序收敛的 GDS 与 signoff（遇 STA 关键路径违例后回到 RTL 流水化）；33 分钟/29 次调用完成 376 行 CAD 插件（通过在宿主二进制中检索报错信息恢复包元数据格式）；18 小时/约 1800 次调用以 PySide6 复刻 3D 建模套件建模工作流；电池表征虚拟实验中估算电动势误差 0.0032 V、内阻相对误差 10.71%；KiCad 软锁存 5V 开关电路/双层 9 封装 PCB 与 J1.1→COL_5 修复；Godot 三款可玩游戏；PnP 位姿精化 GPU 内核融合将 1322 次 kernel 启动降至 1 次，12 项验证通过、几何平均加速 174.8×。

Conclusion: 论文证明"以知识树组织数据、以执行反馈闭环、以多教师在策略蒸馏统一能力、以专用运行时承载工具"的路线可在 27B 规模上同时获得强工程专用能力与不损失的通用能力，且优于同规模基线；并表明智能体价值不在单轮代码生成，而在基于真实工具反馈的跨层诊断、迭代调试与可验证交付物产出。局限与后续：相对最强闭源模型（GPT-5.6 Sol 等）在多个智能体与 DRC 类基准上仍有明显差距，论文亦承认"相对性能随任务波动"；SemiBench 仅 49.70%，说明领域知识深度仍是瓶颈。未来工作为覆盖更全面工业场景并扩展至更大模型规模，目标是能可靠处理更复杂任务的工程智能体。

Abstract: We introduce Micius-Flash, a 27-billion-parameter model for engineering with native multimodal input, deep reasoning and a 256K-token context window. We design the Micius data pipeline as a knowledge-tree-driven data flywheel comprising three stages: knowledge tree construction and expansion, data synthesis, and quality validation with hard-example augmentation. From this data, we train expert models for semiconductor knowledge and reasoning, hardware coding, and semiconductor multimodal understanding, along with agentic experts. Subsequently, we employ Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD) to supervise training on sequences generated by Micius itself, thereby integrating the capabilities of these expert models into a unified model. On more than 20 datasets with about 15K records, Micius-Flash averages 64.2% on hardware code benchmarks, 15.0 points above a same-size baseline. It scores 62.4% on a semiconductor-specific agent benchmark, exceeding the same-size baseline by 17.2 points. We further develop Micius Harness for industrial applications, connecting the model to specialized tools, including EDA tools and KiCad, as well as execution environments. Case studies in PCB design, chip design workflow automation, and software development demonstrate the model's ability to use tool execution feedback for multi-step planning, code debugging, and iterative verification. We release Micius as an open-source model to advance the development of agents for science and engineering.

</details>


### [613] [How Much Skill Orchestration Can LLM Agents Compile Away? Execution-Grounded Specialization for Token-Efficient Skill Use](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10022)
*Jiayi Ni,Zac Wang,Alex Zhang,Zheng Liu,Roopa Prabhu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究「LLM 智能体能否自动把可复用 Skill 的编排过程编译成可执行快路径」。先做零样本技能特化（仅凭请求与 Skill 文本编译，无执行证据），结果失败：编译器对运行时绑定做出错误假设，导致计划脆弱、恢复代价高，含编译调用后 token 反而比直接用 Skill 多 1.24×。据此提出 SkillCache：一种「单轨迹技能特化」方法，把一次已完成调用编译成参数化胶囊（程序 + 自然语言步骤），复用前先重放（replay）做资格校验，并由计划执行器驱动，仅在需要输入/判断/程序失败时把控制权交回模型，同时保留原 Skill 用于恢复。在 Claude Code harness、87 个 SkillsBench 任务上，warm 执行相比 cold 减少 81%（Sonnet 4.6）/74%（Opus 4.8）token，成本降 82%/75%，时延降 72%/69%，奖励基本不变；胶囊还能跨模型迁移（三个开源权重模型平均奖励 +12~25 个百分点，token −72~81%），并在请求发生受控变化时依然有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent Skills（SKILL.md + 脚本/参考文件）为重复性请求提供可复用流程，但每次调用模型仍要重新解读 Skill、重新编排工具调用：冷执行中一个请求中位需 14 次模型调用，每次调用都要重读指令与历史，输入 token 随调用累积（即便有 provider prompt caching 成本仍随调用数增长），且大量调用只做机械工作（拼命令、抄数值）。已有工作多在「Skill 包级别」做源码级编译，或依赖执行轨迹/任务奖励/验证器反馈来演化 Skill，这些信号在部署中往往不可得；人工撰写的 Skill 也优于自动方案。因此本文问：能否在不人工干预、不依赖奖励或验证器的前提下，自动把 Skill 编排「编译掉」，一次性付费、多次复用，并把人类撰写的 Skill 保留为唯一真相来源。

Method: 问题形式化：给定请求 q、技能包 S、工作区 W0、编译/执行证据 h，编译器 C 产生胶囊 z_h，执行器 E 使用它交互，式 (1)。(2) 定义零样本特化（h=∅）；(3) 定义单轨迹特化（h=τ_obs）。

零样本特化研究（Sonnet 4.6、Claude Code、87 任务，3 个超时剔除 → 84 任务）：仅给编译器请求与 Skill，不给任务文件。结果：仅执行部分为直接执行的 0.71×，但加上编译调用升至 1.24×，58/84 任务更贵（sign test p<0.001）；32 个任务出现可观测的程序失败，此时执行部分 0.92×、含编译 1.34×；另有 10 个任务程序「无报错但给出错误答案」，其中 9 个得 0 分；平均奖励由 0.517 降到 0.459。

SkillCache（借鉴 tracing JIT：冷执行=录制轨迹，胶囊=编译后的 trace，程序失败=guard 失败后 deoptimization）三阶段：
(1) Observe：记录冷调用的可观测轨迹 τ_obs（工具调用/参数/结果/错误、模型消息），不含 reasoning、已脱敏凭据。
(2) Compile：隔离的编译智能体在无任务文件的沙箱中读 (q, S, τ_obs)，产出胶囊 z=(μ, B, P, π, V)：μ 适用性描述、B 绑定、P 程序、π 程序与自然语言步骤的交错计划、V 基于请求与 Skill 明示后置条件的验证。编译规则四条：路径剪枝（删失败探索、不新增行为）、绑定提升（请求/工作区相关值升为绑定）、区域融合（相邻确定性操作合并为一个程序，复用已跑通的脚本代码，只改绑定；需语义判断或新观测的保留为自然语言步骤）、有依据的后置条件（禁止与被观测执行的答案比较）。编译器看不到评测器、参考答案与奖励。
(3) Execute：warm 阶段由计划执行器 skillcache-run 驱动程序，模型仅在需要时介入。协议：提示给出胶囊名与描述由模型判定是否命中；未命中按冷执行走；命中时模型先做第一个程序前的自然语言步骤，再用 skillcache-run run 传入绑定启动。执行器顺序运行程序，仅在三种情形交回模型：needs_bindings（一次性索要下批程序所需绑定）、your_steps（交回自然语言步骤，含失败程序）、complete；模型用 skillcache-run continue 回应。程序输出由执行器直接传给读取它的程序，实现免模型的值传递。计划状态文件（position/awaiting/bindings/failed/completed）在每个程序前落盘，支持中断续跑。程序失败判定（非零退出两次、超时、缺失声明输出）即以 program_failed 交回该步（并给出程序源码路径），仅该步离开编译路径，其余计划保持编译，源 Skill 始终可用作恢复。

胶囊资格校验（宿主执行，不调用模型）：Gate 1 结构与数据流（步骤与程序一致、输入输出恰为绑定、唯一生产者且先于消费者）；Gate 2 在新沙箱跑编译器写的语法/构建检查（如 python3 -m py_compile）；Gate 3 端到端重放（用观测示例 E 替代模型应答，失败程序记录诊断、用观测输出替代并继续收集后续失败），最多 3 次修复机会；仍不通过则退化为「文本形式」（书面流程），再失败则仅用源 Skill 执行。示例 E 只用于校验，挂载胶囊时被移除。

对照后端：executor-driven（上述）与 agent-driven（把整个计划放进提示、模型自行调用 skillcache-tool）；还设复用基线 raw trace（把轨迹放入上下文）与 written procedure（从轨迹编译的书面流程）。评测：87 个 SkillsBench 任务、每模型 3 次独立完整流水线、每次执行独立沙箱、1 小时超时，指标含 provider token（含 cache read/write）、列表价成本、模型调用数、时延、验证器奖励（[0,1]）。

Result: 主结果（Table 2/3）：warm 相对 cold，token 减少 80.9%±3.6（Sonnet）与 74.3%±6.3%（Opus），每任务 1313k→247k 与 1063k→273k；成本 −81.6%/−75.1%；时延 −72.1%/−69.2%；奖励 0.538→0.546、0.692→0.690（95% 区间含 0，在运行间噪声内）；模型调用 23.6→5.6、20.9→6.7。token 分解上所有成分均下降，输出 token 降 85%/80%（冷执行 token 中 cache read 约占 95%）。分任务类型节省 −63%~−91%，网络安全与金融方差最大（少数长任务主导）。

对比复用基线（Sonnet/Opus 相对 cold 的节省）：raw trace 54%/49%，written procedure 67%/52%，SkillCache 81%/74%；逐任务 sign test 中 SkillCache 在 82/87 任务上显著更省 token 与成本（p<0.005），奖励无显著差异。

跨模型迁移（Opus 胶囊不改动）：DeepSeek-V4-Flash 低/中 effort 奖励 0.421→0.649、0.384→0.633；DeepSeek-V4-Pro 0.448→0.662；Kimi-K3 0.518→0.678，token 均降 72~81%，任务级 sign test p<0.005；Sonnet 胶囊在 Flash 低 effort 上 0.437→0.553、token −81%。

跨请求迁移探针（instance/rename/reword，24 任务共 23/19/24 个探针）：token −70~87%，奖励 +0.01~+0.15（instance 探针 Sonnet −82%、Opus −72% 且奖励可比）；DeepSeek-V4-Flash 用同一批 Opus 胶囊时 token −71%、奖励 0.54→0.92。失败案例为三个硬编码请求相关值的 Sonnet 胶囊在 instance 探针上给出错误答案。

消融：(a) executor-driven 相比 agent-driven 在同一批胶囊上 token 少 26%/21%，77/70 个任务调用数更少，奖励无差异；即使全用 agent-driven，胶囊表示本身也比 raw trace/written procedure 省 44%/22%（Sonnet）与 38%/32%（Opus），说明表示与执行器共同贡献。(b) 重放消融（在重放改变了已发布胶囊的 65/79 个任务运行上）：发布的胶囊相比「仅通过 Gate1–2 的首个候选」少用 59%±28%（Sonnet）/36%±7%（Opus）token，奖励 0.406 vs 0.368、0.625 vs 0.597（差异不显著）。(c) 零样本胶囊即使换成执行器驱动仍不敌单轨迹胶囊（每次复用比仅用 Skill 更省的任务 59/84 vs 84/87；含编译调用 30/84 vs 67/87）。

成本摊销：全 87 任务编译总花费 $67（Sonnet）/$116（Opus），一次复用即省 $64/$79，聚合摊销点为 1.1 与 1.5 次复用，逐任务中位 1.3/2.2；单次复用即可覆盖编译成本的任务数为 67/87（Sonnet）与 39/87（Opus）。胶囊结构：每模型发布 261 个胶囊，其中 243/247 为 hybrid，混合胶囊平均含 2.8/2.6 个程序、3.4/3.7 个步骤、3.9/5.8 个绑定，89%/74% 的步骤直接调用程序；按类型节省为「全程序」89%/87%、「含自然语言步骤」78%/67%、「纯文本」56%/48%。失败回退罕见：481 次 hybrid warm 执行中仅 11 次把失败程序交回模型（其中 9 次冷执行本已 0 分），仅极少数任务 warm token 高于 cold。

Conclusion: 结论：仅凭请求与 Skill 文本做特化并不能可靠省 token——编译器会猜错运行时绑定，失败恢复代价高；把特化「接地」到一次真实执行（单轨迹）、在复用前用重放做资格校验、再由执行器驱动胶囊，才能把重复的 Skill 编排真正编译掉：warm 执行省 81%/74% token、82%/75% 成本、72%/69% 时延而奖励持平，且能跨模型迁移并在请求受控变化时保持有效（强模型编译一次、开源模型复用）。核心设计原则是：人类撰写的 Skill 作为真相来源不变、执行派生的特化单独存放、失败时逐步 deoptimize 回退到 Skill 与模型。

局限与未来工作：全部实验限于 SkillsBench 与单一 Claude Code harness；存在一次性编译成本，需多次请求摊销；每个胶囊仅来自一次冷执行，可能携带脆弱假设/偏差/错误，且资格校验的重放只用原始请求的取值，硬编码请求相关值的胶囊仍能通过（instance 探针已暴露）；评测中由评测方直接提供胶囊，未检验检索与选择——生产部署还需可靠的缓存检索/选择、执行安全防护、技能或环境变更时的缓存失效，以及让胶囊从 warm 执行中持续学习改进（类似 JIT 编译后续发现的路径），并推广到无 Skill 的重复任务与其他 harness。

Abstract: Reusable skills guide large language model (LLM) agents through recurring requests, but each invocation still requires the model to interpret the skill and reconstruct its orchestration. Can agents automatically compile this orchestration into an executable fast path without human intervention? We first study zero-shot skill specialization, which compiles without execution evidence, and find that despite the skill's procedural guidance, incorrect assumptions about runtime bindings can make generated plans brittle and recovery costly. This motivates SkillCache, a one-trace skill specialization method that compiles a completed invocation into a parameterized capsule of programs and natural-language steps, replays it before reuse, and drives it with a plan executor that returns control to the model only when needed, keeping the source skill for recovery. With the Claude Code harness, warm execution of the same request reduces tokens on 87 SkillsBench tasks by 81% with Claude Sonnet 4.6 and by 74% with Claude Opus 4.8 at comparable reward, and capsules stay effective under controlled request changes. Capsules also transfer across models, raising three open-weight models' mean reward by 12-25 percentage points while reducing their tokens by 72-81%, suggesting that execution-grounded compilation is a promising approach to efficient repeated skill use and cross-model transfer.

</details>


### [614] [NINJA: A Navigator-Inspector Joint Architecture for Context-Efficient Issue Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10027)
*Wenkai Fang,Shunyu Liu,Wei Luo,Zihao Wu,Yang Zhou,Tongya Zheng,Wotao Yin,Jialie Shen,Leszek Rutkowski,Mingli Song,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出 NINJA（Navi-gator-INspector Joint Architecture），一种面向软件 issue 定位（issue localization）的分层多智能体架构：全局 Navigator 负责文件级检索与状态管理，动态调度多个 Inspector 在相互独立的上下文中进行函数级探索，并通过多轮交互汇总可疑位置；再配合两阶段 agentic 微调（SFT 热启动 + 分组件 PPO 强化学习，先训 Inspector 再训 Navigator）。在 SWE-Bench-Lite 与 LocBench 上全面超越 CodeRankEmbed、SWERank+、LocAgent、CoSIL、OrcaLoca、RepoSearcher 等基线；微调后的开源 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct 超过闭源 Claude-Haiku-4.5（文件级 Acc@5 90.6 vs 84.0，函数级 Acc@5 77.3 vs 76.3），且下游 issue 解决率从 28.8% 提升到 45.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Issue 定位（issue localization）是仓库级 issue 解决的关键前提。现有基于智能体的定位方法几乎都是"单智能体 + 持续增长的单一上下文"：轨迹与中间结果不断累积，占用上下文预算并压缩后期推理空间（Cui et al., 2025）；同时这种扁平的顺序探索结构要求同一智能体同时兼顾仓库级广度搜索（找文件）与函数级深度追踪（调用者—被调用者链），并自行分配预算，导致探索失衡、决策负担过重。虽然已有上下文剪枝与相关性过滤方法（如 CoSIL、LocAgent）可去除部分无关信息，但只要仓库规模扩大，多个相关文件区域的累积仍不可避免。此外，早期语义检索方法（CodeRankEmbed、SWERank+）依赖静态代码表示，难以捕捉定位根因所需的多跳结构关系。

Method: 框架（NINJA）：(1) Navigator 维护全局搜索状态 Z_t=(S_t, E_t, Q_t)，分别是可疑函数集、已探索文件集与待检查文件队列；工具含 find_files_by_content、find_files_by_name、dispatch、exit，负责文件级检索、派发入口文件并据反馈决定继续搜索或终止。(2) Inspector 各自从被派发的入口文件出发，仅凭 issue 描述与入口文件启动，不继承 Navigator 轨迹，工具含 get_file_functions/classes、get_code_of_function/class_method、get_callers/get_callees、exit，做函数级检查并可跨文件追踪调用链，返回可疑函数及理由。(3) 交互与调度：dispatch 选出 M_t 个入口文件，按并行度 P 划分为 L_t=ceil(M_t/P) 个 mini-batch 顺序执行，批内并行、批间串行以吸收前批反馈；每批后 Navigator 更新状态（累加可疑函数、记录已访问文件、从队列移除），已访问文件不再重复派发，实现动态调度与去冗余；每个独立上下文预算固定（默认 32,768 token）。任务形式化为 ReAct 范式，终止后拼接 finalization prompt 输出编辑位置集合。
训练（两阶段 agentic 微调）：(1) SFT 热启动：用 Claude-Haiku-4.5 在 SWE-smith-py 上生成教师轨迹，剔除格式非法与定位错误样本（500 例得 462 条 Navigator、275 条 Inspector 轨迹），采用 assistant-only mask 的归一化 NTP 损失训练 2 epoch。(2) 分组件 RL：先训 Inspector（固定 Navigator），再固定已优化 Inspector 作为反馈方训练 Navigator，使用 PPO（critic + GAE，token 级优势）。奖励：Navigator 用全集合 F1 + λφ·工具执行成功率（λφ=1）；Inspector 用局部真值 G*_{e,local}（限定在其访问文件内）F1 + 工具成功率，局部真值为空的轨迹被剔除。基线为 CodeRankEmbed、SWERank+、LocAgent、CoSIL、OrcaLoca、RepoSearcher；评测用 Claude-Haiku-4.5 与 Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct 在 SWE-Bench-Lite 与 LocBench 上，指标含文件/函数级 Acc@5、F1，以及 token 消耗与运行时间。

Result: 主结果（SWE-Bench-Lite，文件级 Acc@5 / 函数级 Acc@5）：NINJA-30B 达 90.6 / 77.3，显著优于 NINJA(Haiku-4.5) 的 84.0 / 76.3、LocAgent(Haiku) 83.1 / 37.2、CoSIL(Qwen3-30B) 79.2 / 24.6、OrcaLoca(Haiku) 70.7 / 52.0、RepoSearcher(Qwen3-30B) 74.8 / 19.9；LocBench 上 NINJA-30B 86.7 / 69.0，同样领先（NINJA-Haiku 83.3 / 65.8，OrcaLoca-Haiku 59.1 / 36.6）。消融显示：合并为单上下文（w/o independent context）函数级 Acc@5 从 71.1 降至 41.5，w/o multi-round dispatch 降至 65.6，w/o dynamic scheduling 降至 69.9 且 token/时间上升。控制实验表明在同等 token 预算（25k/30k）下 NINJA 函数级 Acc@5（63.4/66.4）仍远超 CoSIL（24.6）与 OrcaLoca（39.0）；对 OrcaLoca 施加同样的 SFT+PPO 后其文件级仅升至 74.5，而 NINJA 为 90.6，说明增益主要来自框架设计而非算力或专项训练。微调消融显示 SFT+PPO（90.6）> SFT+DAPO（88.2）> Direct PPO（84.8）> SFT（82.3），PPO 的 critic 提供 token 级优势优于 DAPO。Token 预算 ≥32K 时超限率降至 0.33%/0.46%，性能趋于平台；并行度 P 增大单调提升 token 与时间，过高时因冗余证据干扰决策而性能下降。通用推理能力（MATH500、AIME24/25、AMC23、GPQA-Diamond、MMLU-STEM）基本保持不变甚至略升。下游效用：mini-SWE-agent + Claude-Haiku-4.5 在 SWE-Bench-Verified 上，NINJA 编辑位置提示将解决率从 28.8% 提升至 45.2%（w/o independent context 仅 33.2%），并降低 token 消耗 39.3k→37.8k；真值编辑提示为 52.6%，加上 support location 后达 57.2%，说明 support location 有互补价值。

Conclusion: NINJA 通过"全局导航 + 局部独立检视"的分工协作与多轮动态调度，同时缓解了长上下文累积与"文件广度 vs 函数深度"失衡两大问题，独立上下文使每个检视者的上下文预算保持近似恒定；配合两阶段 agentic 微调（先 Inspector 后 Navigator 的分组件 RL），进一步强化了全局协调与局部探索能力，使开源模型反超闭源强模型。代价是额外运行时（多数情形约为其他智能体方法的 2 倍以内，最高 2.6 倍）与更高 token 消耗，作者将其定位为可配置的"高投入"定位选项。局限包括：层级多智能体带来的运行时开销；实验仅覆盖 Python 仓库（工具设计不绑定 Python，但需语言特定的解析与依赖工具）；support location 定位尚未解决。作者还建议现有定位基准应把 support locations 纳入真值目标，并呼吁未来联合定位编辑位置与支持位置（需语句级证据追踪）。

Abstract: Recent advances in agent-based methods have demonstrated strong promise for issue localization, a critical prerequisite for software issue resolution. However, most existing agent-based methods rely on a single agent with a growing context, where long-context accumulation compresses the effective reasoning space. Meanwhile, the flat exploration structure hinders the balance between file-level breadth and function-level depth. To address these limitations, we propose NINJA, a hierarchical Navigator-Inspector Joint Architecture for context-efficient issue localization. NINJA decomposes repository exploration into global navigation and local inspection: the navigator maintains the global search state, performs file-level search, and dispatches selected entry files, while inspectors independently conduct function-level exploration around the assigned files in separate contexts. Through multi-round interactions, inspectors return suspicious locations as feedback, and the navigator updates the global state to decide whether to continue exploration or finalize localization. This hierarchical design balances file-level breadth with function-level depth, while independent inspector contexts prevent local exploration traces from accumulating in a single growing context. To further strengthen both global coordination and local exploration, we introduce a two-stage agentic fine-tuning strategy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks and LLM backbones show that NINJA consistently outperforms competitive baselines. Notably, after fine-tuning, Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct surpasses the strong closed-source Claude-Haiku-4.5 model. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [615] [SPRING-5: Measuring Tool Documentation Repair for LLM Agents by Efficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10040)
*Guan Zheng Huang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SPRING-5 是一个以「成本」而非准确率为主轴的「工具文档修复」基准：20 个工具族、344 个任务，每个族含确定性后端、植入单一缺陷的降级规格、手写的诚实规格与答案键；主指标为「成本指数」（答错按满额调用预算计费，除以声明的理想调用路径），并始终并列报告「每正确任务调用数」。论文的主要贡献被作者自陈为三项效度工具（build-time 天花板断言、直接测量的噪声下限、dud 规则）而非数据集本身；其最反直觉的结果是：同一份逐字节相同规格的两次评估，95% 比值区间为 0.64–1.56，约八分之一的对比仅凭噪声就跨过常规胜出阈值，而廉价的「机会式」噪声估计因覆盖率偏倚会系统性高估信噪比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动修复工具文档的方法（DRAFT、EASYTOOL、PLAY2PROMPT、DocsChisel）几乎都只用任务成功率/准确率评估，作者认为这是错误的评估轴。理由来自两种失败形态：(1) 文档不清时 agent 通常不会直接失败，而是「本应一次调用却调三次后仍答对」——这在每次请求上持续花费金钱，且对准确率完全不可见；(2) agent 一次干净调用、后端返回格式良好但含义不同的数值并原样上报，transcript 中没有任何错误信号——只被记为一次错误答案，严重低估了该缺陷的杀伤力。此外，Bhat et al. (2026) 的审计显示工具调用基准存在 18.5% 的专家分歧与 23 次运行间 57.9–76.8% 的跨度，说明缺少实测噪声下限的「提升几个百分点」不可解释；基准作者还需回答：数据集的理论最优是多少、差异需多大才算非噪声、哪些族已失去区分力。

Method: 数据集：20 族（344 任务，均匀 train/test），每族含确定性后端、恰好植入一个缺陷的降级规格、手写诚实规格、答案键（期望值 + 理想调用数）。参数集对所有方法冻结（名称、arity、属性集不可改），保证同一动作空间。筛选四条准则：稀有性（称职工程师猜不到的约定）、沉默性（缺陷不靠后端报错暴露）、可分性、组内分布（16 族分布于 7 个语义组 + 4 族构成两组匹配对）。缺陷类：9 输出语义、5 跨参数依赖、4 取值约定、2 操作约束；分类依据来自 Uddin & Robillard (2015) 与 Zhong et al. (2020) 的实测文档研究，并在第三方基准中测到未植入实例。
指标：Charged = 正确会话按实际调用数、错误会话按满额预算 B=25 计；CostIndex = Charged /(R·Σ理想调用数)，GapClosed = (CI_base−CI_A)/(CI_base−1)；另定义 Matched（每正确任务调用数），在所有 arm 都至少答对一次的任务集 M 上计算，不含封顶项、不按结果筛选。区间一律为按族聚类的 bootstrap。
三项效度工具：(1) 构建期天花板断言——诚实规格必须达到声明的理想路径；(2) 直接测量噪声下限（利用降级规格固定，每一次 baseline pass 都是同文本的独立抽样），并证明「机会式估计器」（只取未编辑族做对照）因覆盖率偏倚而收窄区间；(3) dud 规则——强模型冷启动即可解出的族必须点名而非并入均值。
模型与 arm：gpt-5.6-luna（低推理）、gpt-5.6-sol（中推理），25 次调用预算；baseline/optimal 为尺度两端；方法为 easytool（仅 schema）、draft（探测式重写，reimplementation）、session-evo（在线自演化环 + evidence/audit/schedule 触发器 + 配对验收试验）、global-observer（一次性批量读全部训练 transcript）、labelled-observer（额外获得正确性标签，作为 oracle 天花板）。

Result: 主结果（luna，20 族 2 遍）：easytool 关闭 1.0% 缺口 [-10.3%,12.3%]，draft 10.4%，session-evo 12.9%，global-observer 32.9% [14.4%,55.0%]，labelled-observer 58.2%（天花板，不可部署）。单次批量调用优于两个已发表方法的 reimplementation：比 draft 高 +22.5pp [+6.3,+43.3]、比 easytool 高 +31.9pp [+13.6,+53.5]，且只用在线环约 2/3 的训练 token。但这一优势主要来自「读到的证据量」而非架构：把批量臂限制到与在线环相当的曝光（20 vs 23 条 transcript），差距缩至 +3.6pp [-9.8,+16.3]（含 0）；3 条/族为 24.9%，全量为 34.0%。给批量臂加配对验收试验反而净损 -8.5pp [-19.4,-0.7]，因为要留出 30% 训练集做验收，牺牲了让它变好的证据。两个轴排序不同：按每正确任务调用数，labelled-observer 从第一降到第三、session-evo 升到第二（尺度仅 1.20–1.38，无区间，只能读方向）；去掉任一方法重算匹配集（60–65 任务）不改变其余方法的排序。
失败形态：2644 个 baseline 会话中 54% 的错误答案完全静默（无拒绝调用、无拒答、无重试），sol 为 50%；设计与行为仅在 7 个族上一致——静默是行为而非设计属性。
效度工具的结果：天花板断言仅在 event_count 上系统性失败（1.46×，6/6 次跑但无未完成会话，源于诚实文本多宣示了一次确认调用），它已判定此前的 Spring-2 数据集不可用（完美文档仅达理想路径 343%）；直接测得噪声 95% 区间 luna 0.642–1.557、sol 0.712–1.405，机会式估计器在 sol 上只覆盖 11/20 族并把「同文本胜出率」报为 0%（实测 9.2%），且被覆盖的恰是安静族（pass 间标准差 0.026 vs 0.134）；dud 规则在 sol 上判定 4 个族饱和（<1.35×），在 luna 上处于 4.0×–18.3×。
目录规模：1/5/10 工具下效应都存活，baseline 成本不变（13.3×–13.8×），但 2064 个 baseline/optimal 会话零错调，而机器写规格在四次运行中共造成 27 次错调，全部来自 regional_index → capability_probe（改写文本引入 entitlement/authorisation 词汇），说明工具描述不是局部对象，单工具基准无法为此计费。
第三方移植：τ-bench retail 可执行但无 headroom（7/7 族已达理想路径），BFCL v4 live_multiple 有 headroom 但不可执行（成本指数无从计算），汇总结果为零效应（+3.4pp [-0.4,+7.4]）；按「强模型在未改动 schema 上能否答对」分区后，200 条 saturated 查询 baseline 已达 94.5%，98 条 hard 查询仅 2.0%，audit/schedule 在 hard 层分别升到 7.1%/8.2%。逐条读 121 条双模型未答对的查询：119 条路由正确，78 条两模型给出逐字节相同却被 key 拒绝的调用；72 条（59.5%）在描述重写动作空间内可达（50 条是「类型不允许的 sentinel」冲突——正是本文刻意植入的取值约定类，在第三方数据中自然出现；20 条多余可选参数；2 条值形未述），49 条不可达。作者还修正了自己的 scorer（类型强制转换），使 BFCL baseline 由 55.1% 升至 59.1%。
统计功效：族间标准差 0.45 时，真实差异 0.10 的检出率 19%、0.20 为 54%；80% 功效需约 39 族（0.20）或 162 族（0.10）。

Conclusion: 文档缺陷不会随模型进步离开生产系统，只会离开我们度量它们的能力；因此任何该领域的头条数字都是易腐的，后继数据集必须更难而非更大。论文建议：(1) 在任何汇总数字旁报告 dud 族数并点名；(2) 报告「强模型在未改动文档上跑一遍」的分区结果，任何评测文档修复的基准在引用池化数字前都应先分区；(3) 报告直接测得的噪声下限，任何用固定阈值报胜率的工作若不附直接噪声下限，报告的是效应与方差的未知混合。成本指数主要追踪完成率（封顶项占计费总量的 93–97%，与完成率在 20 族上符号从不冲突），故必须与 matched cost 并列报告；只在一个轴上出现的结果应如实标注。batch 相对 online 的优势来自读到的证据量而非架构，且结果仅在「后端不变」的静态条件下成立，版本漂移可能削弱甚至反转它，这是自然的下一个检验。相对外部的迁移尚未成立：成本主张从未在本数据集之外被检验，最受支持的贡献是三项效度工具。

Abstract: Methods that repair tool documentation automatically are mostly evaluated on task accuracy. We report a benchmark that scores them on cost. SPRING-5 is 20 tool families and 344 tasks, each with a deliberately degraded specification, a hand-written honest one, a deterministic backend and an answer key, scored on calls charged against the ideal call path. A wrong answer is charged the full call budget, so this cost index largely tracks the completion rate, and we report calls per correct task beside it, which carries no such charge. Over 2,644 baseline sessions, 54% of wrong answers arrive with no rejected call, no refusal and no retry. The benchmark carries three validity instruments. A build-time ceiling assertion requires the honest specification to reach the ideal path and fails systematically on only one family. A dud rule names the families a stronger model solves cold and catches four. A directly measured noise floor shows that two evaluations of a byte-identical specification differ by a 95% factor of 0.64 to 1.56, so about one comparison in eight crosses a conventional win threshold on noise alone, and the cheap way of estimating that floor is biased by which families happen to go unedited. Against these instruments, a schema-only method closes 1% of the baseline-to-ideal cost gap, an online self-evolution loop 13%, one batch rewrite over every training transcript 33%, and a variant given correctness labels 58%. The batch advantage over the loop is the evidence it reads: held to the loop's exposure it is no longer detectable. With five and ten tools in context the effect survives, the baseline cost does not change, and only machine-written descriptions sent calls to the wrong tool. On BFCL, 62% of held-out queries are already answered from the shipped documentation, which explains a pooled null there. Code, data and runs are released.

</details>


### [616] [Longtail-SWE: High-Quality SWE Tasks for Underrepresented Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10304)
*Vladimir Dobrovolskii,Ibragim Badertdinov,Alexander Golubev*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Longtail-SWE 是一个面向 13 种"长尾"编程语言（Clojure、Dart、Elixir、Erlang、F#、Haskell、Julia、Kotlin、Lua、OCaml、R、Scala、Swift）的仓库级 issue 修复基准，包含 202 个高质量任务。其核心方法是在 SWE-rebench V2 基础上构建"求解器—裁判—修复器"（solver–judge–repairer）流水线：利用求解轨迹诊断并修复任务描述与测试的缺陷，从而把本会被过滤掉的稀缺难题回收进来。最佳模型 Opus 5.5 (high) 取得 81.52% Pass@1、89.11% Pass@3；对照 SWE-rebench V2 原始路径最终仅能保留 68 个任务，改进路径保留 202 个（最终 A 标注 196 vs 66，约 2.97 倍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库级 SWE 基准（SWE-bench、Multi-SWE-bench、SWE-PolyBench、SWE-Bench Pro 等）主要覆盖 Python 及少数主流语言，许多编程语言生态在现有评测中几乎空白，限制了评估"智能体在不同库、工具链与开发实践上的能力"这一研究。现有任务构建范式（从历史 issue/PR 采集、以参考补丁为真值）存在根本缺陷：(1) 仅验证参考补丁能通过测试不足以保证评测可靠性——PR 自带测试可能拒绝合法的替代实现（false negative），描述可能遗漏智能体无法推断的需求（欠规格化），而测试覆盖不足又会放过错误解（false positive）；(2) 简单过滤会把可修复的任务直接丢弃并使基准组成偏向小改动代码，在任务池本已稀缺的生态中尤其可惜（作者引用 SWE-bench Multilingual 发布说明指出，要求描述清晰且测试无歧义会偏向小规模代码修改）。此外，作者注意到 SWE-bench Verified 等人工审核工作同样采取"剔除"策略而非"修复"策略。因此动机是：与其丢弃有缺陷但可修复的候选任务，不如联合精修描述与测试，从而在长尾语言中保留足够数量且可靠的高难度任务。

Method: **基准构建（基于 SWE-rebench V2 扩展）**

*任务定义与流水线四阶段*：collection → construction → repair → dataset finalization。任务沿用 SWE-bench 设定：问题陈述（来自 GitHub issue）+ pre-fix 仓库（base commit）+ 可执行环境 + reference patch + evaluation test patch。在 base commit 应用测试补丁得 F2P 测试（修复前失败、修复后通过），P2P 测试作为回归检查。评测协议统一：解补丁在全新独立容器中评测，丢弃求解器对测试文件的改动后再应用评测测试补丁；成功=全部 F2P 与 P2P 通过。

*1) 候选收集与筛查*：按语言用 GitHub API 收集与单一 issue 关联的已合并 PR；要求可用 base commit、非空且可分离的参考/测试补丁。仓库需 ≥10 star、2026-01-01 后更新、非归档/未禁用、宽松 SPDX 许可。PR 需已合并、关联单一 issue、非 bot/非依赖更新、≤1000 文件、生产补丁至少新增 5 行等。容量受限时按修改文件数、再按补丁长度降序优先处理大补丁。语义筛查用 Kimi K3 给出 SWE-rebench V2 的诊断类别：保留 A（描述完备可直接解）以及两类"可修复"类别 B2（测试要求了陈述中缺失的名称/签名/取值）、B5（测试可能依赖参考实现的偶然细节）；排除需外部信息、视觉上下文、非英文理解等类别。

*2) 环境构建与初始审计*：每语言构建一个或多个带版本的 base Docker 镜像以适配运行时/构建系统差异。auditor agent（Kimi K3）从 base commit 出发阅读仓库文档、配置与 CI，推断项目原生的安装/构建/测试命令，安装任务依赖并用既有测试验证安装；同时比对问题陈述、仓库上下文、参考补丁与测试补丁，必要时修订测试以泛化实现特定的检查或补充缺失覆盖；并可将问题陈述中的实现提示替换为 `[HIDDEN]`（最终 202 个任务中 56 个任务共 113 处）。可复现性检查：在干净容器中从头重跑安装/构建/测试，要求至少一个 F2P 且应用参考补丁后全部评测测试通过；再为每个任务构建预装依赖镜像并复检，比对保存的测试分组与任务配置，只有全部成功才进入下一阶段。

*3) solver–judge–repairer 诊断与修复*：solver 尝试解题；judge 在任务专属 Docker 镜像中审阅求解轨迹、解答补丁与评测结果，并对照陈述、参考补丁与测试，区分"实现错误"与"描述/测试/环境缺陷"；通过测试但仍错误的解可暴露边界情况覆盖缺失。judge 接受则任务交由下一个**不同模型配置**的 judge 复核，任一新问题则退回修复；任务须被三个顺序 judge（GPT 5.6 Luna xhigh、GPT 5.6 Terra high、Kimi K3 high）**全部接受**方为完成。repair agent 依据 judge 诊断修订评测测试补丁或**仅追加**澄清（写入 appendendum），初始审计产出的陈述（含 `[HIDDEN]` 替换）在修复期保持不可变；参考补丁全程不变；repairer 不得借测试补丁夹带生产代码修复；环境缺陷需退回构建阶段。描述修复阶段用 Kimi K3 high、GPT 5.6 Terra high、GPT 5.6 Luna xhigh 的求解尝试，陈述与 addendum 冻结后的测试修复阶段改用 GPT 5.6 Sol high。修订后的测试须在 base commit 与原参考补丁下均满足执行标准，失败则保留上一个已验证版本并回传错误日志；参考补丁有缺陷的任务直接丢弃。测试仅变更则重放已有解答补丁，陈述变更则需新的求解尝试。最多 5 轮为一组迭代，直至三 judge 均接受或识别出坏参考补丁；每语言接受满 30 个任务即停止采集（237 个难度入选任务平均修复 4.2 轮，中位 4，范围 0–14），所有中间修订、轨迹与裁定全部留存。

*4) 基准定稿与发布*：难度校准用 Qwen 3.8 27B (xhigh, 262K) 每任务跑三次，除语言保底需 ≥15 个任务外剔除三次全解的任务（保底时优先保留平均轨迹最长的）。后期评测验证：基于 8 个模型配置 × 每任务 3 次共 5,688 条已存求解尝试，先修评测器缺陷（补丁应用、测试输出解析），再重放解答补丁，人工 + GPT 6 Luna / Claude Opus 5.5 / GPT 6 Astra / GPT 6 Sol 辅助审阅陈述、测试、参考实现与执行日志，剔除无法在不改变意图下修复的任务，最终 202 个。

*评测设置*：9 个模型配置（Opus 5.5 high、GPT 6.1 Sol high、GPT 5.6 Sol high、GPT 5.6 Luna xhigh、Kimi K3 max、DeepSeek V4 Flash high、GLM-5.3-Flash max、Qwen 3.8 27B xhigh、Qwen 3.6 27B thinking），统一 SWE-agent 类脚手架，每任务 3 次；指标为 Pass@1（±SEM）、Pass@3、All-3、平均总 token 与步数。难度校准用的 Qwen 3.8 尝试不计入报告分数，但作者承认仍存在模型依赖的选择偏差。

Result: **总体性能**：Opus 5.5 (high) 最优，Pass@1 81.52%±1.16、Pass@3 89.11%、All-3 73.76%；GPT 6.1 Sol 78.38%、GPT 5.6 Sol 75.74%、GPT 5.6 Luna 71.45%、Kimi K3 63.70%、DeepSeek V4 Flash 56.11%、GLM-5.3-Flash 48.18%、Qwen 3.8 27B 42.74%、Qwen 3.6 27B 16.67%。即便 Opus 三次尝试后仍有 10.89% 任务未解。

**资源与一致性**：GPT 6.1 Sol 最省（1.75M token、27.4 步），Opus 4.48M/53.2 步，Luna 约 13.01M/76.5 步（约为 Opus 三倍），Kimi 16.84M/151.4 步，GLM-5.3-Flash 最高（38.28M/313.7 步）。Qwen 3.8 27B 十次尝试的 pass@k 从 43.8% (k=1) 升至 73.3% (k=10)，边际收益递减，26.7% 任务十次仍未解，说明很多任务"可解但不可靠"。

**语言差异**：按配置等权平均，Erlang 最高 73.5%，Haskell 72.8%、R 69.0%；Clojure 48.1%、F# 50.2%、Elixir 50.4% 最低，最高最低相差约 1.5 倍。Opus 5.5 在 4 个语言子集领先，在 Erlang 与 GPT 6.1 Sol 打平、Lua 与两个 Sol 配置打平、Swift 与 Sol/Luna 打平；Kimi K3 在 R 领先。

**消融（构建流水线）**：共同候选池 3,261；SWE-rebench V2 路径仅留 A 类 1,096 → 严格 EV 通过 377 (34.4%)，Longtail 路径保留 A/B2/B5 共 2,640 → EV 通过 1,247 (47.2%)；在同一 1,096 个 A 候选上，合并审计器将 EV 通过从 377 提升到 539 (49.2%)，其中 331 (61.4%) 个任务的测试补丁被改写。分语言 EV 增益：Kotlin 6→86、Scala 2→78、Swift 9→54。端到端漏斗：SWE-rebench V2 路径最终 68 个任务，Longtail 路径最终 202 个；最终 A 标注 66 vs 196（2.97 倍）；修复质量审查后接受 533 个，难度入选 237 个，后期验证排除 35 个。额外用单个 GPT 5.6 Luna (xhigh) judge 审查 SWE-rebench V2 路径的 364 个任务，90.1% 被指至少有一处质量问题（82.4% 隐藏测试依赖未文档化 API/精确输出，88.7% 测试覆盖不足），仅 9.9% 被接受，说明原始路径产物的评测可靠性严重不足。

**修复效果（固定补丁配对实验）**：在 63 个陈述未变、仅测试被修复的任务上，用完全相同的 Opus 5.5 三条轨迹重放，Pass@1 从 29.1%→67.2%（+38.1 点），Pass@3 从 36.5%→77.8%（+41.3 点），All-3 从 20.6%→54.0%（+33.3 点）；同样 63 任务的 Qwen 3.8 27B 十次尝试，Pass@1 15.2%→31.0%、Pass@10 36.5%→68.3%。

**Judge 可靠性（人工验证）**：65 个分层审计任务，两名工程师独立标注分别标出 44 与 41 个问题任务，仅在 40 个上一致（Cohen's κ=0.15），经协商得到金标 14 ACCEPT / 51 REJECT。顺序三 judge 协议共拒 56 个，正确识别 51 个问题任务中的 49 个：以"拒绝"为正类，precision 87.5%、recall 96.1%，漏检 3.9%，误拒 12.5%。

**数据统计**：202 任务来自 129 个仓库、13 种语言；每任务平均 513 词陈述、13.1 个改动文件、414.8 行参考补丁新增、645.9 行测试新增、24 个 F2P、42.9 个 P2P。任务类型：核心特性 67.3%、重大 bug 27.2%、集成特性 12.4%、边界 bug 9.9%。LLM 难度标注：易 7、中 73、难 122。修复轮数均 4.22。全部材料（任务、可执行环境、工具链、agent 轨迹、容器镜像、易任务伴随集）以 MIT（代码）/ CC BY 4.0（数据）发布于 GitHub SWE-rebench/Longtail-SWE。

Conclusion: **结论**：Longtail-SWE 将仓库级 issue 修复评测扩展到 13 个此前覆盖不足的语言生态，交付 202 个经"求解器—裁判—修复器"流水线精修的高质量任务与配套易任务集，并在 9 个模型配置上给出最高 81.52% Pass@1 / 89.11% Pass@3 的实测水平。核心经验是：描述与测试的联合精修能把本被过滤的稀缺难题回收为可靠评测对象——相对 SWE-rebench V2 原始路径最终产出提升约 2.97 倍（196 vs 66），且在固定解答补丁的配对实验中证明测试修复本身可带来 +38.1 点 Pass@1。

**局限与有效性威胁**：构造效度上，虽然参考补丁固定、澄清仅追加，修订仍可能改变任务契约，且描述修改的独立效应未被单独评估；65 任务人工审计显示高召回（96.1%）但低特异度（50.0%），加上标注者一致性低（Cohen's κ=0.15），部分合格任务被不必要地送入修复，抬高构建成本。内部效度上，难度筛选依赖 Qwen 3.8 27B，其报告分数存在模型依赖的选择偏差，部分评测模型也参与了构建。污染无法排除（源自公开 issue/PR，训练截止日期常不公开），但流水线支持按日期限制任务创建时间。外部效度上，仓库/PR 过滤（许可、热度、单 issue 关联、优先大补丁）与每语言仅 12–27 个任务，使语言差异反映的是任务与配置样本而非语言固有难度。作者亦指出需独立审计以确定最终基准的真实错误率，并将进一步研究模型参与构建对其分数的影响。

Abstract: Challenging repository-level benchmarks remain limited for many programming language ecosystems, where filtering scarce candidates with ambiguous descriptions or defective tests can discard valuable engineering problems. We introduce Longtail-SWE, a benchmark of 202 issue-resolution tasks across 13 languages with limited coverage in existing repository-level benchmarks: Clojure, Dart, Elixir, Erlang, F#, Haskell, Julia, Kotlin, Lua, OCaml, R, Scala, and Swift. Its construction uses a solver--judge--repairer pipeline: a solver attempts each candidate task, and a judge reviews the task together with the solver's trajectory and test results to guide revisions to tests and task descriptions. These revisions aim to correct tests that reject valid alternative implementations or accept incorrect solutions while retaining challenging tasks and preserving their intended requirements. We evaluate nine model configurations, including frontier models, and analyze task-solving performance, consistency across repeated attempts, and resource usage. We release all benchmark instances, executable environments, complete construction and evaluation tooling, and agent trajectories, together with an additional set of easier tasks to support evaluation of smaller models.

</details>


### [617] [Hybrid Source Code Change Impact Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10958)
*Katharina Stengg,Christian Macho,Martin Pinzger*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文针对源代码变更影响分析（CIA）提出两项贡献：(1) 构建并人工标注数据集 Constantinople——在 Alexandria 基础上扩展为 263 个提交、22 个开源 Java 项目、1,931 个被改代码实体（seed/impacted/non-related），覆盖方法、字段、类及新增方法，使用全限定名（FQN）以支持方法重载；(2) 提出混合方法 katIA，先用静态分析（Spoon）生成初始影响集，再由 LLM 精化，分单提示版本 katIA-SP 与三智能体版本 katIA-MA。katIA-SP（Gemini 2.5 Flash）FQN 匹配 F1 = 22.4%、CE 匹配 F1 = 27.0%（比 Ripple 高 2.0 个百分点）；katIA-MA 达到 FQN 29.1%、CE 33.3%（比 Ripple 高 8.3 个百分点），代价是中位生成时间 0.570s→11.214s、token 1,235→6,462。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CIA 方法（如 Chianti、Athena、Ripple）在精确率或召回率上表现不佳，且所依赖的 Alexandria 数据集存在四类局限：仅覆盖方法变更、缺失方法签名（无法处理 Java 重载）、缺失新增方法、未明确标注 seed change（各方法采用启发式假设），从而使已发表评测结果存在偏差。同时缺乏更贴近真实开发场景（一个 bug 可能涉及多个 seed、涉及字段与类变更）的基准数据集。

Method: 1) 数据集构建：基于 Alexandria 的 918 个手工解缠提交，按仓库/提交/父提交分组，过滤测试文件与非 Java 文件，保留改动 1–5 个生产代码文件的提交；三阶段人工标注（校准 20 个 → 共享 100 个 → 各自独立 100 个，共 420 个样本），用 Jaccard 集合重叠衡量标注者一致性（整体约 56%）；借助基于 Spoon 的标注工具导出 CSV；最终剔除 117 个不含 seed 与 impacted 的提交及 20 个重复提交，得到 263 个提交、1,931 个实体（498 seed / 1,327 impacted / 106 non-related）、252 个 Jira 缺陷报告。2) katIA 方法：阶段一克隆父提交并用 Spoon 解析，按实体类型（类、含构造器的方法、初始化块、字段）抽取依赖形成初始静态影响集；阶段二用 LLM 精化——katIA-SP 采用单个含系统提示、背景说明、任务描述、输入项与输出格式示例的提示；katIA-MA 分解为 Analysis Agent（为静态集实体产出证据并提出需新建实体）、Refinement Agent（据证据增删实体）、Reporting Agent（仅按格式输出）三个智能体。3) 实验：经 OpenRouter 固定 provider 选用 GPT-5.4 Mini、Qwen3 Coder Plus、Gemini 2.5 Flash，temperature=0，每组实验重复 3 次取各提交中位数；以 precision/recall/F1 分别在 FQN 匹配与 CE（类名+实体名）匹配下做宏平均；另报告一致性、生成时间、token 与成本；与 Ripple（GPT-4o）对比。

Result: 静态分析基线：FQN 匹配 P15.8%/R23.5%/F1 14.6%，CE 匹配 P16.9%/R24.9%/F1 15.6%。katIA-SP：GPT-5.4 Mini F1 15.8%(FQN)/18.5%(CE)；Gemini 2.5 Flash F1 22.4%/27.0%（CE 精确率 39.9%）；Qwen3 Coder Plus F1 25.2%/28.5%（表现最佳但仅 41.83% 一致性，263 个提交中仅 110 个三次结果完全一致）。Gemini 2.5 Flash 一致性最高（262/263，99.62%），GPT-5.4 Mini 最低（57/263）。katIA-MA（Gemini 2.5 Flash）全部 263 个样本一致，FQN P32.9%/R33.8%/F1 29.1%，CE P37.8%/R38.0%/F1 33.3%，相比 katIA-SP 显著提升召回、精确率基本持平。资源开销：katIA-MA 相对 katIA-SP 中位 token 5.2×、生成时间 19.7×、成本 13.0×（中位 11.214 s、6,462 tokens、0.626 美分），作者认为代价可接受。结果表明 LLM 主要充当静态影响集的“过滤器”，在精确率与召回率间存在权衡。

Conclusion: 静态代码分析与 LLM 推理相结合的混合方案 katIA 可改进变更影响分析，多智能体变体优于单提示变体并超越此前最好结果；LLM 结果的一致性应作为软件工程研究的常规评测指标。总体绝对性能仍然偏低（最佳 F1 仅 33.3%），说明 CIA 仍是极具挑战的问题。局限：仅覆盖 Apache 生态 Java 生产代码、排除测试与配置文件、项目分布不均、缺乏多智能体消融实验、LLM 无源码访问权限。未来工作：赋予智能体完整源码与专用工具、扩展数据集与变更类型标签、开展消融分析与智能体对话日志分析。

Abstract: Change impact analysis (CIA) helps developers identify code entities impacted by their initial changes. While several approaches for CIA were proposed, they still struggle with either low precision or low recall, thereby increasing manual effort for developers to verify the results. Furthermore, limitations in the used datasets and experimental setups can bias the results reported by many CIA approaches. In this paper, we first address the dataset limitations by manually labeling 1,931 changed code entities stemming from 263 commits of 22 open-source Java projects. Next, we introduce two variants of katIA, our code change impact analysis approach that combines static impact analysis with the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). The first variant uses a single prompt (katIA-SP) for refining an initial static impact set while the second variant uses three specialized agents (katIA-MA). The evaluation with our curated dataset shows that katIA-SP with Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved an F1-score of 22.4% when matching impacted entities by their fully qualified names (FQN) and 27.0% when matching them by their class and entity names (CE). The latter shows an improvement of 2.0 percentage points over the state-of-the-art. This score is further improved by katIA-MA which, using Gemini 2.5 Flash, yields an FQN-matching F1-score of 29.1% and a CE-matching F1-score of 33.3%. While these improvements come at the cost of increased median generation time from 0.570 s to 11.214 s and median token usage from 1,235 to 6,462 tokens, the improved performance justifies the additional cost. The comparison of three LLMs using katIA-SP finds that Gemini 2.5 Flash is the most consistent model. These results indicate that combining static impact analysis with LLM-based refinement, particularly with the multi-agent variant, can improve code change impact analysis.

</details>


### [618] [Advancements in Cloud-Native Systems: A Systematic Mapping Study of Reliability and Scalability across Cloud-Native, Edge-Native and AI-Enabled Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11040)
*Shrinivass Arunachalam Balasubramanian*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Cloud-native systems now extend to the network edge and host artificial-intelligence (AI) workloads, including AI agents, but evidence on their reliability and scalability is scattered and uneven. We report a PRISMA 2020 systematic mapping study with an evidence-graded synthesis. Five logged OpenAlex searches on 11 October 2026 covered cloud-native systems, edge AI, agentic AI for operations, reliability of agentic applications and physical AI; 189 records from an earlier exploratory search were added separately. After 301 duplicate removals and an automated peer-review venue rule, 4,611 records were screened against written criteria and a five-level relevance scale. The review includes 1,794 primary studies from 2017-2026 and 95 secondary studies, with every decision released in Dataset S1. Each primary study was assigned to a 13-category taxonomy and graded as simulation, prototype or testbed, production data, production deployment, or not determinable from the abstract. Of 1,003 studies with a determinable level, 66.2% used prototypes or testbeds, 18.0% simulations and 15.8% production data or deployments. A 93-study synthesis core, appraised from indexed abstracts, shows production deployments of cascading-failure prevention, trace- and graph-based root-cause analysis and predictive autoscaling, and production-trace evaluations of cold-start mitigation. Edge reliability and physical AI rely mainly on simulations and testbeds. AI-agent reliability uses tool-grounded diagnosis, explicit safety properties, trace-driven repair and workload-aware scheduling, while empirical studies show that agent frameworks remain fragile. Conclusions are limited to the documented corpus. The principal gaps are production evidence for edge-native systems, shared resilience benchmarks and dependable agentic operations.

### [619] [Replay Fidelity in LLM Agent Evaluation: Randomness, Hidden State, and Test Oracles in AppWorld](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11216)
*You Liu,Quanchao Lu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Reproducibility in large language model (LLM) agent evaluation depends on replay fidelity: which parts of an execution trace are reconstructed, controlled, and compared. This matters for agent debugging, failure analysis, and counterfactual evaluation of stateful tool use. We audit all 71 unsuccessful executions in a fixed historical AppWorld corpus using 284 isolated fixed-code replay attempts. Reconstructed declared settings admit 42 cases under printed-output, pre-oracle database-delta, and native-verdict/test-count checks; resetting the random-number generator before each interaction admits 68. The 26-case gap contracts to four under database/oracle checks, with one endpoint unknown. Mechanism studies identify four materialized-state discrepancies despite matching outputs and verdicts. In one admitted endpoint pair, an identical API call yields matching responses but different row effects; common future Python RNG removes that deterministic difference in two paired repetitions. A separate JWT credential-equality program and alignment controls expose authentication/write differences, with missing repetitions retained. For all 10 affected post-oracle export cases, native export from retained output trackers restores the reference comparison without changing original cached contents. A purposeful 12-case BFCL pilot shows no discrepancy under its tested public-state, return, and verdict checks. We preserve resource censoring and infrastructure deviations. The contribution is a bounded empirical characterization of replay eligibility, hidden state, and test-oracle integration, without estimating debugger accuracy, repair gains, or method-ranking distortion.

### [620] [Feeling Easier, Working Harder: Cognitive Load in AI-Assisted Code Comprehension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12019)
*Maryangela White,Maximilian Rose,Matthew Buckman,Amy McDonnell,Francisco Ortega,Bianca Trinkenreich*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Software developers spend significant time reading and understanding code, increasingly supplemented by generative AI. While these tools aim to reduce the difficulty of reading code, interacting with them introduces a dual-task environment that may impose extraneous cognitive load that is challenging to capture. This study investigates how access to generative AI affects developers' real-time cognitive workload, code comprehension performance, and self-perceived code comprehension strategies. We conducted a 3x2 within-subjects study with 20 novice CS students reviewing Java code snippets of varying lengths with or without AI assistance, followed by an AI-unassisted comprehension quiz. Cognitive workload was continuously captured using a Detection-Response Task (tDRT) during both reading and quiz phases, and compared to post-quiz NASA-TLX and SEQ scores. AI assistance significantly increased objective cognitive workload, raising tDRT reaction times by 11.2%, yet participants' perceived workload remained unchanged. Code comprehension scores were high under both conditions, with no evidence that AI assistance improved comprehension at the difficulty levels evaluated; a ceiling effect limited power to detect benefits on harder tasks. Qualitatively, participants reported trusting the AI conditionally -verifying its output against their own reading for more complex snippets, but directly trusting it for simpler code- and, while many felt their reading process was unchanged, a notable subset shifted toward skimming or reading the AI's explanations in place of the code itself. These findings reveal that developers do not accurately perceive the cognitive resources they expend when managing AI tools. This study provides evidence of added cognitive effort associated with using generative AI, pointing towards a need to account for this dual-task penalty in software engineering tools and education.

### [621] [AWS Serverless Infrastructure from WebAssembly Components](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11293)
*Philipp Vollmer*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: The infrastructure definitions and the code for serverless applications are often only loosely connected. This yields a large error class: the referenced infrastructure components might not exist. It is also hard to keep the application and its permissions in sync. To address this problem we present an infrastructure from code solution where we provision cloud infrastructure from Wasm Interface Type (WIT) - the language defining the interface of WebAssembly components. We limit ourselves to the basic example of an AWS Lambda function accessing S3 buckets. We build two interpreters for the WIT language: one that derives the definition of S3 buckets as infrastructure as code and least-privilege IAM permissions, and a generic runtime that runs the component as a Lambda function and provides access to the S3 buckets as capabilities. We formulate consistency properties that ensure the existence of the S3 buckets and correct permissions of the Lambda, and provide evidence that our interpreters satisfy them. We show how selected failures for deployment of such cloud components can be prevented using our technique and how a baseline setup fails at this task. Together with the strict sandboxing of the WebAssembly runtime we achieve an instance of capability-based security for access to AWS infrastructure as a further result.

### [622] [Mutation Testing for Multi-Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09895)
*Nafiseh Kahani,Mojtaba Bagherzadeh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems are defined by explicit workflows, agents, tools, tool-access rules, and delegation paths. Most evaluations, however, report end-to-end task success rather than whether a test suite can detect faults in this coordination structure, such as a removed delegation, a silently removed restriction, a misrouted tool edge, or a faulty tool implementation. We adapt mutation analysis to this setting, fourteen operators in four families (delegation, allowed-tool, restriction, agent/instruction) perturb a normalized workflow manifest, and three kill criteria score whether a suite catches the change, namely K-Struct on the observed coordination, KOutcome on the task verdict or step sequence, and K-Safety on a forbidden tool call. Every criterion is evaluated by executing each suite against the original and the mutant through the OpenAI Agents SDK, with k=3 repeats and a majority vote. On ten OpenAI Agents SDK-derived workflows (49 reachable agents, 47 tools, 403 obligations), the evaluation executes 29,601 agent runs over a pool of 1,084 mutants. We use T-Struct only as a full-obligation reference point (MSstrict=1.000 under all three criteria) and measure how much the baseline suites miss, the bestperforming one (T-Dev*) reaches 0.717 (K-Struct) and only 0.559 (K-Safety). Restriction-removal (RES-REM) is the least detected fault for the baselines (0.19 to 0.28 vs 1.000). Executing the suites also allows the obligation-preserving operators (TOOL-FAULT, AG-SWAP, AG-PROMPTDROP) to be evaluated. A manifest-only oracle would not witness these changes. In this setting, tasksuccess- style suites catch only about half of permission violations.

### [623] [From Prompt Engineering to Programmatic Prompting: Toward a Software Engineering Discipline for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09896)
*Sebastian Dingler*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: The practice of instructing large language models (LLMs) through natural-language prompts has, in the span of a few years, migrated from an interactive curiosity to a load-bearing component of production software. Yet the vocabulary, tooling, and mental models of the field remain anchored in its interactive origins: we still speak of "prompt engineering" as though the crafting of a single well-worded instruction were the central problem. This paper argues for a categorical distinction. Prompt engineering, we contend, is an interaction technique - a human-computer interaction skill for eliciting desired behavior from a model in a conversational or exploratory setting. Programmatic prompting, by contrast, is an engineering discipline governing the behavioral interface between software systems and language models: the construction, composition, versioning, testing, and maintenance of prompts as first-class software artifacts embedded in larger systems. Conflating the two has produced brittle applications, unrepeatable evaluations, and an accumulation of prompt debt. We make three contributions: (1) a definition of programmatic prompting; (2) a systematic differentiation of programmatic prompting from prompt engineering, prompt tuning, fine-tuning, and general LLM application development; and (3) an account of prompt debt that distinguishes the self-admitted debt measurable in code from the silent debt that surfaces only as incidents, and identifies its economic cause. Our thesis is simple to state and consequential to accept: prompt engineering is an interaction technique; programmatic prompting is an engineering discipline.

### [624] [Executable Specifications as First-Class Independent Verification and Validation Artifacts for Quantum Information and Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10023)
*Ragib Shahariar Ayon,Shibbir Ahmed*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Executable specifications make software assumptions explicit and checkable, yet their role in quantum information and machine learning (QIML) remains underexplored. We argue that executable specifications should be treated as first-class artifacts for independent verification and validation (IV&V) of QIML systems. Static analysis, testing, simulation, and runtime checking can provide evidence about QIML behavior, while Design by Contract shows that selected quantum-state, measurement, and statistical properties can be expressed as checkable conditions. However, adapting existing methods for specification inference and assessment from conventional and machine-learning software to QIML raises several challenges, notably limited evidence for deriving generalizable specifications, cross-stage and probabilistic behavior, repository-scale reasoning across hybrid workflows, and weak behavioral oracles. We characterize these challenges and identify research directions for QIML corpora, specification semantics, repository-level analysis, and specification assessment.

### [625] [Between Spark and Silicon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10025)
*Zihao Wang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Generative agents make it easy to imagine hardware design as a conversation followed by compilation. Yet faster register-transfer-level (RTL) generation does not ensure a faster, defensible engineering decision. This perspective argues that the operative unit of hardware agility is an accepted change supported by current, scoped, and independently governed evidence. We revisit key developments in executable verification, design generators, integrated implementation, and agentic design automation, distinguishing historical capabilities from vendor claims and recent benchmark results.

### [626] [Ninada: Sub-Clause Split-Graph VITS Streaming and Capability-Routed 24 kHz Speech Synthesis Across Twelve Scripts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10035)
*Hemanth HM*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: End-to-end VITS text-to-speech models synthesize natural speech in a single forward pass, yet standard ONNX exports execute monolithically over an entire clause, delaying Time-To-First-Audio (TTFA) to several seconds and spiking activation memory. Client-side deployment across Indic scripts faces four further bottlenecks: 138.8 MB float32 checkpoints per language strain browser caches, mobile WebGPU stalls for 6-14 s compiling convolution shaders while still running slower than real time ($1.44\times$ RTF), small WebAssembly pthread pools stall at barriers on this http URL mobile CPUs, and mobile Web Audio pipelines drop frames or mute output under AudioWorklet contention and iOS WKWebView rules. We present Ninada, an open-source 24 kHz TTS system covering English, Classical Sanskrit, and ten Indian languages (sa, en, hi, kn, mr, bn, ta, te, ml, gu, pa, or) across a capability-routed 48-checkpoint fleet: 24 studio HiFi-GAN v1 specialists (27.9 MB W8A32+FP16 ONNX) for desktop/WebGPU and 24 distilled c8c8_384 iSTFTNet specialists (21.7 MB ONNX, $2.64\times$ fewer vocoder MACs via an exact NOLA dual-window ConvTranspose1d inverse STFT with zero complex ops) for mobile WASM, plus a 0.0 MB zero-dependency Klatt fallback. At runtime, Ninada splits a single ONNX file in memory in $< 15$ ms into prior, flow, and windowed vocoder sub-sessions streaming 12-frame halos with raised-cosine crossfades. On $N = 480$ held-out 24 kHz studio utterances, Ninada achieves 3.22 dB 0-8 kHz MCD (3.09 dB mobile iSTFTNet; 1.33 dB 24-voice distillation MCD, vs. 5.17 dB for the 1,526.8 MB 16 kHz Meta MMS fleet) and 6.07 dB 8-12 kHz error, delivering 89-155 ms audible startup on desktop WebGPU and 538-649 ms zero-underrun streaming at 0.75-0.76x RTF on a physical Google Pixel 10 Pro XL.

### [627] [From Delegation to Action Approval: An Exploratory Study of Developers' Practices in Collaborating with AI Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10058)
*Yinan Wu,Dominik Wermke,Ze Shi Li,Kathryn Thomasset Stolee,Bowen Xu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Developers now collaborate with AI coding agents that write code and take actions on their behalf. Beyond reviewing this code, developers decide what to delegate and which agent actions to approve. Some of these actions, such as running shell commands or reading files, can have effects that never appear in the resulting code. How developers make these decisions and how much effort this requires are not well understood. To better understand this collaboration, we surveyed 203 developers who use AI coding agents. We found that careful code review does not necessarily extend to action approval: 61% of developers who carefully reviewed most or all generated code still often approved at least one type of agent action without close review. Developers aware of security or privacy incidents or concerning practices did so more often than those who were not. We also found that autonomy varied more between developers than between development activities. Although developers reported a lighter workload, supervising agents remained mentally demanding. When asked what would make them grant more autonomy, developers wanted more than reliability: more than half of their responses called for agents that are bounded, observable, or reversible. Our findings suggest that as agents take on more of the coding, the challenge shifts toward supporting the developers who supervise them.

### [628] [Done Is Not Correct: Measuring Silent Failures and Self-Verification Calibration When LLM Agents Take CAD Actions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10063)
*Carson Rodrigues,Clive Rodrigues,Aravind Reddy G*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: When a large language model (LLM) agent writes parametric CAD code from a natural-language specification, syntactic success decouples from semantic correctness. We release a benchmark and harness that measure this gap directly: 13 specification tasks whose every requirement maps to machine-checkable properties of the produced B-rep, measured by the kernel against published tolerance bands, with reference solutions and the full graded attempt corpus. The exact, self-audited oracle isolates two quantities no prior CAD benchmark reports: the silent-failure rate (a valid, renderable solid, an explicit completion claim, and at least one failed semantic check) and completion-claim calibration. Across four models from four vendors (156 attempts per architecture), single-shot agents claimed completion on 98% of attempts and were silently wrong on 14.1%; a tool-use loop that enforces measure-then-claim cut silent failures to 3.2% and raised claim precision from 64% to 96%, and a four-model ablation attributes the change to the claim contract rather than the feedback. A planner-coder-checker pipeline matched that precision at lower coverage with no success gain. Stated confidence was miscalibrated single-shot (ECE 0.32) and became informative under verification for three of four models. Hardening our own oracle flipped 18 of 519 regraded verdicts from pass to fail and none in reverse; a blind expert audit overturned 3 of the 18 silent failures outside the one ambiguously specified task; and fourfold scaling of every tolerance band leaves the contrast intact.

### [629] [Autonomous Code Review: Hidden-Test Results on GitHub Issues](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10098)
*Adam Shakhabov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Can an autonomous cross-provider review step change whether code written for a real issue passes hidden tests? We report a retrospective benchmark of 12 historical GitHub issues (five C#, five JavaScript, and two Python) from five repositories. Two directed author--reviewer pairs, OpenAI GPT-6.1-Sol and Anthropic Claude Sonnet 5.5, each ran twice per issue, yielding 48 planned workflows. A bounded terminal agent produced an initial patch; a cross-provider model reviewed it; the author model adjudicated findings and could revise the patch. The same hidden evaluator assessed initial and final patches. Forty workflows completed, while eight terminated before a complete evaluator outcome. Four completed workflows passed, and all four already passed before review. No initial-to-final pass/fail transitions occurred among completed workflows.

### [630] [Retention Horizons of Volatile Stores in iOS and Android Extractions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10309)
*Daniel Kwaku Ntiamoah Addai,Sanders Larweh Tetteh,Selorm Adjabeng,Kingsley Albert Egyir*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Whether an extraction can answer a question about a given day depends on how far back each store reaches, yet public statements rest on single test devices. We measured the retention horizon, the time from a store's oldest retained record to acquisition, for eight iOS and seven Android stores on 48 full file system extractions and seven bug reports, keeping devices whose clock agreed with the acquisition time (26 Apple devices, 13 Android phones). Horizons ranged from minutes to years and followed the mechanism that bounds each store. The unified log Persist stream reached a median of 2.5 days; interactionC reached 166 to 170 days on 18 of 25 devices. Android stores stayed within their source-code limits (usage statistics 10.2 days, DropBox 3.1, notifications 1.5); bug-report logs reached 3.1 hours at most. The oldest record misled three times: one knowledgeC stream reached back two years, the others a median of 29 days; interactionC read without its write-ahead log showed older records on 18 of 25 devices; and four of seven bug reports began with stray lines up to 16.6 days old above a body of 3.1 hours or less. A horizon belongs to a store, a release and a device.

### [631] [Device-Life Boundary Indicators and the Classification of Restored Versus Native Records on Android](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10312)
*Daniel Kwaku Ntiamoah Addai,Selorm Adjabeng,Kingsley Albert Egyir,Sanders Larweh Tetteh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: A phone that shows calls, messages and photographs from years ago may have been set up recently and carried them over from an earlier handset, so its screen dates do not date the device's own life. Which traces fix where that life begins, how well they agree and how much of what is visible predates it is unmeasured. We read 14 Android full file system extractions (12 Samsung; Android 10 to 16), seven bug reports and 33 iOS extractions (a probe). Every Android device recorded a first boot, but the first evidence of user setup came a median of 98 days later (0 to 563). Of the 13 devices with messages, 7 held some dated before the first boot, a majority of them on 5; 24% of the apps outside the system image were installed as restored. Against the creator field that a migration tool leaves on messages, a boundary at user setup recalled all but 1 of 46,968 such messages, the first-boot boundary 94 to 100%. On synthetic fixtures, the labelling error followed the boundary error. A date on a record dates the device only once the record is shown to have been created on it.

### [632] [Caleta: An Evidence-Oriented Trust Layer for Reproducible Local Large Language Model Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10324)
*Joan-Marc Fisa*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Local large language model (LLM) inference is often described as private, verified, or reproducible without separating the technical claims behind those terms. This paper presents Caleta, an Apache-2.0 process supervisor and evidence layer around this http URL rather than a new inference engine. Caleta combines versioned manifests, exact-size and SHA-256 verification, controlled backend construction, a restricted OpenAI-compatible proxy, prompt-free execution records, benchmark reports, and a small conformance suite. Its contribution is the composition of these mechanisms into explicit contracts that distinguish integrity from authenticated provenance and privacy controls from operating-system isolation. We evaluate the implementation through static checks, 22 unit tests, deterministic end-to-end tests on Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows, and a pinned real-model experiment on Windows CPU using Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct Q4_K_M and this http URL b11981. The real experiment validates artifact verification, startup, model listing, non-streaming and server-sent-event chat, and conformance. Three independent benchmark invocations produced fifteen successful warm requests with no failures. In this single configuration, median time to first token was 18.066 ms and median decode throughput was 54.394 tokens/s. These descriptive measurements do not establish cross-engine superiority, output quality, energy efficiency, or hardware-general performance. Raw JSON, commands, and environment metadata are published. Remaining challenges include signed manifests, time-of-check/time-of-use replacement, operating-system containment, proxy-overhead measurement, and broader experimental matrices.

### [633] [Mismeasuring the Life of a Line of Code: Lessons Learned the Hard Way](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10530)
*Pavel Gurov*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Studies of how long lines of code live, including lines written by AI agents, rest on choices that look technical: when a line counts as gone, what to do with lines still alive, whether to pool projects, and how to evaluate a model. We studied 32.5 million line births in 120 TypeScript repositories and got several of these choices wrong at first. For ten of them, we compare the result as we first computed it, or as commonly done, with the result after correction. All ten change conclusions, or would have. Six were our own mistakes. Counting moved and rewritten lines as dead shortens a line's median life from 3.0 years to 1.3. Counting any change as a death hides an outcome that can be predicted: within-project concordance falls from 0.71 to 0.56. Regressing observed lifetimes discards three quarters of the lines. Keeping rewritten lines at risk makes protective effects grow with age. Lines are born and removed together, so treating them as independent misleads twice: nine of fifteen effects look significant only under that assumption, and a split by file makes a barely predictable outcome look good (within-project concordance 0.71 instead of 0.61). After the corrections, removal depends on a line's age and project, but our models could barely rank it within a project. Local revision they could rank (0.71). Obvious cases aside, the top 1% of a project's new lines are revised at 2.3 times the base rate. Each pitfall leaves a symptom; we give a checklist.

### [634] [What extraction cannot slim, and whether function injection can: a pre-registered study of 580 Java repositories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10545)
*Daniel Sagenschneider*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: A method of 26 code lines or more reads as a Long Method, and Extract Method is the usual fix. Some long methods have no single-exit fix: a return cannot leave an extracted piece, a piece hands back one value, and some methods are knotted so that every cut is blocked. Function injection, as the OfficeFloor framework does it, cuts differently: each piece becomes a function the framework injects and sequences, an early return ends a function, and a function hands on several values. The framework's author pre-registered a test of whether it takes apart what extraction cannot. A stratified random sample of 580 open-source Java repositories, each pinned before AI coding assistants were in general use, was scanned by released tools whose cost models were fixed before the sample was drawn: 3,026,902 methods, 168,466 of them long. Single-exit extraction cannot slim 22.8% of the long methods. The registered hypothesis, that at least a quarter of those stuck methods are ones only function injection takes apart, is refuted: 22.2% (95% CI 20.3 to 24.3). Nearly half of the stuck methods are early-return methods the plan counts as conventionally fixable, and the split takes three in four of those apart as they stand. Where extraction would do, the split chooses injection and costs less for 29.0% against extraction wrapped as one function and 17.2% against plain extraction, almost always as a straight sequence of functions. An exploratory reading of the quarter of the stuck methods that neither takes apart finds a third of it tables and literals, long for their data rather than their logic, and most of the rest blocked by a jump inside a loop, by a nested statement too large to cut, or by values too many for any cut. Three registered studies are proposed: the classes as rules in the tools, a refinement per class, and the same measures on code written with AI assistants.

### [635] [Safe by Accident: Crash-Testing LLM-Written Code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10585)
*Afridi Mahmud,Md. As-Aid Rahman,Rifat Shahriyar*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Evaluations of LLM-written code run it once, in one environment, and credit the code with whatever passes. We show that this credit can belong to the environment. We crashed LLM-written backend code just before each database, file and email call, re-ran it as an operator would, and judged the result under two transaction modes of Python's sqlite3: the default, in which the library quietly opens a transaction, and autocommit, in which it does not. Across 9,100 solutions from ten models on 24 backend tasks, more than half (54%) of the database code that survives every crash in the default mode is left half-updated in autocommit mode. This holds for every model, and it hides in ordinary code, including with conn: blocks that look like transactions but open none. Telling the model that its connection is in autocommit mode does not change what the local code models write, while the API models' unsafe share falls by 30 points. Asking for crash safety helps every model, and strong models repair nearly all unsafe code, but often write safe code only when asked. Thus, much of the crash safety that LLM-written database code appears to have is borrowed from the library rather than designed into it, and a second test under a less forgiving configuration reveals the difference.

### [636] [SIExBench: A Benchmark for Automated Repair of Sensitive Information Exposure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10776)
*Mingming Zhang,Xu Wang,Jian Zhang,Dihao Fan,Xiangxin Meng,Chunming Hu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Modern software systems routinely process credentials, personal records, and other sensitive information. A sensitive information exposure (SIEx) defect makes such information accessible to an unauthorized actor and can cause serious and often irreversible disclosure. However, prior research has focused largely on detecting such exposures rather than repairing the underlying defects, and existing repository-level issue-resolution benchmarks do not specifically target this defect class. We present SIExBench, to our knowledge the first benchmark dedicated to automated repair of SIEx defects. SIExBench contains 161 execution-verified instances from 64 widely used Python and Java repositories, each with an issue report, buggy repository snapshot, developer patch, executable exposure and regression tests, and defect characterization. We evaluate six repair systems with three LLMs, yielding 18 configurations, and systematically analyze their overall effectiveness, performance across defect characteristics, and failure mechanisms. The strongest configuration resolves only 39.1% of the instances, while 40.4% remain unresolved by all 18 configurations. More importantly, 62.1% of unsuccessful attempts produce a valid patch that still leaves sensitive information exposed, making incomplete exposure removal a central challenge. Systems often generate plausible patches and modify relevant code without fully eliminating the exposure, indicating that effective repair must ensure that all relevant paths to sensitive-information exposure are closed. Overall, SIExBench provides a foundation for systematically evaluating and advancing automated repair of sensitive information exposure defects.

### [637] [Patch correctness in automated program repair: A five-dimensional evidence framework and cross-benchmark audit from classical repair to coding agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.10837)
*Shuai Wu,Yanna Feng,Yufang Li,Xue Li,Zhijun Wang,Bolun Liu,Weilin Cai*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Tests guide automated program repair and determine which candidate patches are reported as successful. Repository-level coding agents extend this feedback loop by generating tests and revising code after observing execution results. This technical report introduces a five-dimensional evidence profile and reporting protocol to audit how test observations support patch-correctness claims across classical repair systems and coding agents. We assemble an audit dataset of 39 benchmark and evaluation artifacts: 32 primary empirical studies, one institutional technical audit, and six prior taxonomic baselines. We code the 33 primary contributions along five dimensions: test provenance and exposure, behavioral scope, oracle basis and dependence, execution integrity, and label adjudication. The central distinction separates checks visible during repair search from evidence reserved for final assessment. Four worked comparative audits show how changed candidate populations, oracle rules, or execution budgets alter reported detection rates. Additional tests can expose missed faults while rejecting valid alternatives or reducing correct-repair yield under a fixed budget. Repository-level audits separate issue reproduction from candidate-patch discrimination and distinguish automated discrepancy detection from requirements-based adjudication. An evidence matrix links each coded decision to supporting passages and records shared benchmark ancestry. We specify a reporting protocol for repair benchmarks and maintenance pipelines that retains uncertain judgments and records validation cost alongside fault detection and valid-patch retention.

### [638] [Application-Defined Abstractions to Separate Numerical Intent from Computation Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11100)
*Elena Aschmann,Anshu Dubey,Mohamed Wahib,Jens Domke*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: In High-performance Computing the holy grail has been to translate numerical algorithms expressed in mathematical notation into code that performs well across a range of platforms. A variety of portability frameworks have abstracted data layout, parallelization and orchestration from application's view, however, the resulting format is still code that conforms to the idioms of the framework. Additionally, substantial refactoring is typically needed to achieve performance goals. Increasing sophistication of Large Language Models (LLMs) naturally raises the question whether they can be used to make application codes and/or solvers both portable and performant. The obstacle is the lack of correctness guarantee in LLM produced code. In this paper we pose the question differently -- can we start with expressing numerical intent of the code into an immutable core arithmetic component isolated from the surrounding code such that the surrounding code can be safely generated by the LLMs? We answer this question by using Spark, a mature compressible hydrodynamics solver in Flash-X, a multiphysics software system. We use LLM assistance in devising the abstractions and embedding them in the solver. Once properly verified, the resulting solver is lowered to concrete realization deterministically with tools also built with LLM assistance. The driver of the numerics and the code for interfacing with the application are generated by the LLMs. The resulting solver is exercised within Flash-X and with a separate environment we built for this experiment. Our results show that this is a viable approach for producing correct and performance portable code.

### [639] [Beyond Code Translation: Agentic Android-to-HarmonyOS Migration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11192)
*Yinghang Ma,Wuyang Dai,Song Wang,Filipe Cogo,Zhen Ming,Jiang*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Migrating Android applications to HarmonyOS is an important yet challenging software engineering task. Existing large language model (LLM)-based migration approaches primarily translate code at the method or file level, overlooking project-wide dependencies and workflow coordination. Moreover, ArkTS, the primary language for HarmonyOS, is relatively low-resource, and migrated applications often lack sufficient tests for reliable verification, making end-to-end migration error-prone. We present A2HTrans, an agentic framework for end-to-end Android-to-HarmonyOS application migration. Rather than performing isolated code translation, A2HTrans decomposes applications into functionality-aware migration tasks, prioritizes them through dependency analysis, and orchestrates translation, validation, and iterative repair within a unified execution workflow. To improve migration reliability, A2HTrans employs a tool-augmented verification strategy that combines compiler-based syntax checking with LLM-based semantic validation and automated repair. We evaluate A2HTrans on 14 Android applications spanning diverse sizes and domains using Claude-Sonnet-4.6 as the underlying migration model. Compared with Claude Code, A2HTrans preserves 8.3% more functional completeness, improves behavioral correctness by 8.0%, and reduces migration time by 28.8%. These results demonstrate that structured agentic execution substantially improves the reliability and efficiency of project-level cross-platform software migration.

### [640] [NumericalDiff: Numerical Program Differencing via Value-Based Trace Alignment and Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11213)
*Xiang Chen,Huanhuan Xia*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Numerical programs implementing the same computational task can exhibit different numerical behavior because of their execution stacks, program representations, or program logic. Source text and final outputs alone provide limited diagnostic information: numerical differences can propagate through corresponding computations, while distinct executions can produce equal outputs. We present NumericalDiff, an execution-based method that records assignment-level numerical events, aligns traces using a tolerance-aware longest common subsequence independent of variable names and source locations, and optionally reexecutes after replacing one intermediate value with its counterpart. Among the original and all single-intervention executions, it lexicographically maximizes matched events and minimizes unmatched events. NumericalDiff supports code comparison across language and framework front ends, currently including NumPy, PyTorch, JAX, C, C++, Fortran, and Octave. We evaluate NumericalDiff on 36 controlled cases comprising 675 pair/input instances: 36 execution-stack, 588 program-representation, and 51 program-logic instances. All 24 operator-injection instances expose trace differences, including three with tolerance-equal final outputs, while complete trace alignment is achieved for all 441 canonical cross-representation instances. Within the 51 program-logic instances, intervention improves 24 alignments and raises macro-average matching coverage from 0.4210 to 0.6513. The results show that value-based trace alignment and reexecution can delimit propagated numerical differences across heterogeneous implementations.

### [641] [SWHForest: A Structural Curation and Search Layer for Large-Scale Code Corpora](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11439)
*Federico Pennino,Andrea Gurioli,Maurizio Gabbrielli,Paolo Ferragina*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Pre-training code language models relies on massive code corpora usually streamed over the internet. However, researchers rarely need a multi-terabyte archive in its entirety; instead, their workflow centers on curated subsets: selecting well-documented files, filtering out repetitive boilerplate, auditing for benchmark contamination, or retrieving specific code patterns. Yet, because modern corpora are typically published as file pointers and basic attributes rather than source text, no general structural layer exists to select which files to download: curating a subset requires downloading and parsing millions of files first just to discard most of them. We present SWHForest, an open-source framework and public dataset that provides this missing structural layer for any pointer-based corpus without redistributing source code. A single pass over the archive parses each file into an AST and immediately discards the source text, keeping only its structural summary. Queried locally or exposed by archive providers as a server-side filtering API, SWHForest selects matching files first (via SQL or index intersection) and downloads only surviving candidates. Across the ten largest languages of Stack-Edu (52.1M unique files, 341M definitions), SWHForest answers curation queries in milliseconds while cutting downloads by 46-72%, reducing live structural searches from hours of per-language streaming to seconds or minutes.

### [642] [MicroSim: Contrastive Graph Neural Networks for Binary Code Similarity Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11486)
*Moussa Moussaoui,Tarik Houichime,Abdelghani Souhar,Abdelalim Sadiq*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: We present MicroSim, a system for binary code similarity detection that represents each function as a graph built from IDA Pro Hex-Rays microcode and compares such graphs with a contrastive Siamese graph neural network (GNN). We evaluate on the TREX cross-optimization benchmark, a corpus of 849,072 function-level microcode graphs spanning optimization levels -O0 through -O3, under a strict class-disjoint split in which no function key is shared between train and test. Under this protocol, MicroSim reaches 0.9972 area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) and 0.9762 Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC), outperforming Gemini (0.9332 ROC-AUC), SAFE (0.9752), and jTrans (0.9740) retrained on the same split, as well as a structure-free Bag-of-Words (BoW) baseline (0.9484). We analyze the gap between pair classification and ranked retrieval in graph transformers, showing that Cross-domain Similarity Local Scaling (CSLS) under unified tie-resolved evaluation raises GraphGPS mean reciprocal rank (MRR) from 0.2542 to 0.2559 (R@1 = 0.1639, R@10 = 0.4561), strictly satisfying the theoretical MRR upper bound. Finally, over 5 seeds with equal compute, the pairwise cosine-embedding loss attains a slightly higher ROC-AUC ({\Delta} = -0.0256, 95% confidence interval [-0.3282, +0.2770]), whereas the supervised-contrastive information noise-contrastive estimation (InfoNCE) loss is significantly better on thresholded classification and ranked retrieval.

### [643] [CRUSTPairs: A Cross-Language Dataset of Paired C and Rust Solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11711)
*Vojtech Hejlek,Leonardo Jesus Almeida,Alneu de Andrade Lopes*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: C-to-Rust migration is an active agenda, but no dataset pairs the two languages at the level of whole solutions to a shared problem. We present CRUSTPairs, 1857 C/Rust implementation pairs drawn from competitive programming archives, normalised, deduplicated, and stratified into difficulty tiers by zero-shot cross-language embedding similarity, with perrecord provenance and licensing. Cross-language retrieval is hard on this data, and harder than a single baseline would suggest: TF-IDF over shared identifiers reaches MRR 0.21 and so beats a pretrained code model at 0.19, which on the hardest quarter of the data scores 1.7x chance. Finetuning reaches 0.79, and lifts that hardest quarter 10x. Renaming every user identifier settles what is being learned: the finetuned models keep 96-97% of their accuracy without them, while the pretrained model keeps 66\% - less than the lexical baseline does - and on structurally divergent pairs the finetuned models are better without identifiers than with them.

### [644] [Decalage: Uncovering the Gap Between Model-Generated Reasoning and Actual Code Implementation in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.11721)
*Saif Uddin Mahmud,Afsana Tasnim,Ahmed Ryan,Md Rayhanur Rahman*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: Agentic code generation often asks a model to explain its reasoning before it writes code, and a common way to make such a workflow safer is to add a security instruction to the prompt. We test what that instruction does in small language models, which are attractive because they run locally and cheaply. Four open code models of 1.5B to 3B parameters generate C++ from 166 sections of eleven public requirements documents, once with a general prompt and once with a secure prompt. The secure prompt more than doubles the share of reasoning about validation, resource handling and threats, and we find no evidence that the rise is larger for requirements with security content. The code changes only in part. Among functions with a body and reasoning, the share with a check that our lexical test recognises rises from 23% to 39%, but more than a quarter of the functions remain stubs, compile rates stay low, and half or more of the functions whose reasoning mentions a check contain no such check. Two rounds of compiler-feedback repair leave more than 80% of sections unusable, and neither cppcheck nor an exploratory ESBMC run separates the prompts on the usable code. A hand check by two annotators supports the stub measure and the direction of the reasoning result. For small models, a security instruction changes the reasoning broadly but the code only in part, so the reasoning should be checked against the code rather than trusted.
